decisions.decision: Narrowed the debug session to the undo-timer defect only, instead of all four Phase 03 UAT defects
decisions.rationale: The other three already had confirmed root causes and prescribed fixes recorded in 03-UAT.md. Debugging them would have rediagnosed known causes. 03-UAT.md itself prescribed /gsd-debug for the timer defect specifically.

decisions.decision: Fixed the undo-timer defect with persist: false rather than any timer or cubit change
decisions.rationale: Root cause is a Flutter 3.38 breaking change: SnackBar computes persist = persist ?? action != null, and ScaffoldMessenger's timeout callback early-returns on persist before reaching hideCurrentSnackBar. The timer always fired. persist: false is the official migration.

decisions.decision: Used unawaited(...) in 03-08 instead of copying the analog's bare .then
decisions.rationale: The analog at task_form_screen.dart:52 is itself one of the 65 accepted discarded_futures infos; copying it would have made 66 and failed the gate. unawaited is the wider presentation-layer convention (4 uses). Measured 25 discarded_futures before and after.

decisions.decision: Pinned an explicit locale on every MaterialApp in the new 03-06 tests
decisions.rationale: This project's widget tests default to en, not pt_BR. resolveCategoryDisplay returns nameEn whenever preferEnglish && nameEn != null, so a locale-less test would render 'Food' and the intended 'Alimentacao' assertion would fail.
